Nivel de vechime: Director
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de resurse umane
Krownlex is a recruitment and headhunting company built on the belief that hiring can be done better and differently. The company focuses on understanding each client’s organizational culture, mission, and values to identify candidates who truly fit. Krownlex provides tailored recruitment solutions for a variety of roles, emphasizing both professional skills and personal attributes. Potential applicants can expect a people-centered approach that values long-term success and meaningful career matches.
 About the opportunity 
 On behalf of our client, an established and expanding international company, we are recruiting an autonomous, highly experienced Chief Accountant with strong Odoo ERP proficiency, active CECCAR certification, and advanced English communication skills.
 In this role, you will take complete end-to-end ownership of the internal accounting and reporting functions—managing the entire operational cycle from primary accounting records up to and including the final statutory Balance Sheet, alongside payment runs, financial analysis, and intra-group reporting for headquarters.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Accounting operations & Balance sheet ownership 
 Oversee and execute the complete accounting cycle—processing and reconciling all primary documentation (AP, AR, GL, fixed assets) through to monthly/annual closing and the preparation and filing of the statutory Balance Sheet.
 Management & Intra-group reporting 
 Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual intra-group reporting packages according to group standards (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow), perform budget vs. actual variance analyses, and track financial KPIs for group leadership.
 Treasury & Payments 
 Manage daily banking activities, coordinate and authorize vendor payment runs, follow up on receivables, and maintain cash flow forecasts.
 Odoo ERP 
 Drive accounting workflows inside Odoo, maintain analytical cost centers, and reconcile automated entries from Sales, Purchasing, and Inventory modules.
 Tax compliance & Audit 
 Ensure complete statutory and fiscal compliance, prepare and submit VAT returns, corporate tax filings, and mandatory declarations, serving as the primary liaison for external auditors and tax authorities.
 Candidate Profile 
 Professional certification: Active CECCAR certification is required.
 Experience: 5+ years of solid full-cycle accounting experience, with proven ownership from primary records up to and including the final statutory Balance Sheet.
 ERP proficiency: experience working with Odoo ERP (Accounting and Invoicing modules).
 Reporting acumen: Solid experience in financial analysis, management reporting, and delivering structured intra-group reporting packages to parent company standards.
 Language skills: Advanced English for corporate reporting and international stakeholder communication.
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related economic field.
 Technical competence: In-depth knowledge of local statutory accounting principles, tax legislation, and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
 Workplace presence: Available for a full-time, 100% on-site schedule at the client's office in Fagaras.
 What our client offers 
 A competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience, along with a benefits package including private medical insurance and meal vouchers.
